boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Samford traditions, from student-produced Step Sing rituals to campus gatherings across the academic year.

cards.title: Step Sing
cards.subtitle: Student-produced singing and dance competition
cards.notes: Attend a performance to see student groups combine musical arrangement, choreography, costumes and a themed production.
cards.short_summary: A Samford competition that grew from a 1951 sing-along into a large student-organized show.
cards.evidence_claim: Samford says Step Sing began as a 1951 sing-along and is organized by students who handle musical arrangement, choreography and costume design.
cards.access_notes: Held at the Wright Center; consult the event page for current performance details.

cards.title: Step Sing Banner Drop
cards.subtitle: The Step Sing season opener at the Wright Center
cards.notes: Watch each participating group reveal its banner and show title, then look for the banners when they move to later displays.
cards.short_summary: A reveal event where Step Sing groups drop banners and disclose their show themes.
cards.evidence_claim: Samford's 2026 Step Sing program describes Banner Drop as the event that officially starts the season, with groups dropping banners to reveal titles and themes.
cards.access_notes: The program identifies the Wright Center as the Banner Drop venue.

cards.title: Step Sing Signature Moves
cards.subtitle: Recognizable gestures tied to participating groups
cards.notes: During performances, notice recurring gestures or short sequences and the onstage shout-outs that reference another group’s move.
cards.short_summary: Groups build recognizable choreographic calling cards into Step Sing culture.
cards.evidence_claim: Samford's 2026 Step Sing program says participating groups develop recognizable signature gestures or short choreographed sequences and may incorporate another group's move as a shout-out.
cards.access_notes: See this as part of a Step Sing performance; individual groups determine their own moves.

cards.title: Connections Weekend
cards.subtitle: New-student welcome tradition
cards.notes: New students are placed in upperclassman-led small groups for campus and Birmingham introductions, mixers and other scheduled events.
cards.short_summary: A structured first-weekend welcome that connects incoming students with peers and campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Samford calls Connections Weekend a beloved tradition for new students and says each student is placed in a small group led by upperclassmen.
cards.access_notes: Samford states new students are automatically registered; view the current Connections information for programming.

cards.title: Bulldog Walk
cards.subtitle: Home-football pregame walk
cards.notes: Arrive before a home kickoff to line the route from the University Center toward the Sullivan-Cooney Family Fieldhouse.
cards.short_summary: A pregame procession that sends the football team from the University Center toward the fieldhouse.
cards.evidence_claim: Samford identifies Bulldog Walk as a tailgate tradition that begins two hours before home-game kickoff at the University Center's south entrance and ends at Sullivan-Cooney Family Fieldhouse.
cards.access_notes: Samford schedules it for all home games, beginning two hours before kickoff.

cards.title: Homecoming Board Displays
cards.subtitle: Student-organization displays on Ben Brown Plaza
cards.notes: Walk Ben Brown Plaza during Homecoming to view the decorated boards created by participating student organizations.
cards.short_summary: A visual Homecoming tradition in which organizations create displays for campus visitors.
cards.evidence_claim: Samford reports that student organizations decorate Homecoming Board Displays and display them on Ben Brown Plaza throughout Homecoming weekend.
cards.access_notes: Available during Homecoming weekend; the article locates the boards on Ben Brown Plaza.

cards.title: Alumni Candlelight Dinner and Awards
cards.subtitle: Homecoming recognition tradition
cards.notes: Check the Homecoming schedule for this alumni gathering, which recognizes service and distinguished careers through three award categories.
cards.short_summary: A Homecoming dinner and awards ceremony with roots reaching to the 1860s.
cards.evidence_claim: Samford describes the Alumni Candlelight Dinner and Awards as a time-honored tradition dating to the 1860s that recognizes alumni in three categories.
cards.access_notes: This is part of Homecoming programming; current attendance details depend on the annual schedule.

cards.title: Lighting of the Way
cards.subtitle: Centennial Walk Christmas tree lighting
cards.notes: Join the December countdown on Centennial Walk, with the Christmas story, carols, tree lighting and a closing concert.
cards.short_summary: A December gathering built around luminaries, carols and the Centennial Walk tree.
cards.evidence_claim: Samford says Lighting of the Way lines the quad with luminaries and culminates in a Christmas-story reading, carols, tree lighting and concert.
cards.access_notes: Samford describes it as occurring at the start of the Christmas season on Centennial Walk.

cards.title: Your School Your City
cards.subtitle: Fall welcome concert and Birmingham introduction
cards.notes: Visit the Quad concert and browse the local-business tents to learn about Birmingham-area options during the fall welcome week.
cards.short_summary: A fall campus welcome that introduces students to Birmingham through a Quad concert and local vendors.
cards.evidence_claim: Samford says Your School Your City introduces students to Birmingham and surrounding communities through a Quad concert and tents from local businesses and restaurants.
cards.access_notes: Samford places this event each fall; consult the full event calendar for current details.

cards.title: Spring Fling
cards.subtitle: End-of-classes outdoor campus gathering
cards.notes: Look for the end-of-classes program on Ben Brown Plaza and the Quad, with outdoor activities, food trucks and a concert.
cards.short_summary: A late-spring student gathering intended to mark the close of classes before finals.
cards.evidence_claim: Samford's Student Government page describes Spring Fling as a program in the last three days of classes with outdoor activities, food trucks and an outdoor concert.
cards.access_notes: Samford describes Spring Fling as taking place during the final three class days; verify the annual schedule.
